scope: Public catalog research, no product edits, no outreach, no deployment

outcome.limitation: Ten selected query-verified major/academic/special library systems plus two reserves, not a verified national top ten. UMT is a policy-blocked reserve; Punjab stable identity was resolved via official legacy OPAC. NUML robots remain unknown. No complete production-ready ten-largest set established.

market.recommendation: Promising second-wave country: large population and reusable Koha skills, but access-policy/endpoint work materially reduces immediate coverage.
market.common_lms: Koha is the strongest reusable platform lead; nationwide dominance or market share not established.

independent_lms_evidence.claim: 2023 study of27 university libraries in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa: Koha10/27 (37%). Regional institutional sample, not a national census.

largest_networks.claim: 193 membership entries; some duplicates/branches/offline entries. Koha Cloud homepage reports41 hosted catalogs. Neither number is a verified count of distinct usable endpoints.
157 participating libraries self-reported, fast cached and live search modes. Requires Z39.50 per onboarding guide; backend catalogue is not proof of current holdings.

market.best_unlock: PASTIC/PakCat partnership for permitted national catalog access/Z39.50 or agreed API; robots currently block /result and /api/ and tested PASTIC-hosted Koha instances block all bots.
market.public_reach: National Library (reference only), State Bank and public/nonprofit libraries have wider access potential. Academic libraries dominate verified endpoints but borrowing/entry is generally restricted. A discovery result is not a lending entitlement.
market.platform_mix: Selected ten: three Koha, one SLiMS, one Insignia, two LibMax and three custom catalogs. Two additional Koha reserves (UMT blocked; SAU scale uncertain). This convenience sample is not market share.

methodology: Live urllib HTTP requests with identifying MyBookshelfResearch user-agent; exact synthetic title phrases, not real user data. No auth/captcha/certificate bypass.
Bounded response HTML saved (maximum2MB per generic response); timestamps from UTC environment clock. Search engine indexing used to discover/source scale, never counted as successful catalog query.
No credential use, registration, borrowing transaction, outreach or deployment. Hidden private download links not followed.
Initial urllib.robotparser allowed UMT incorrectly; corrected using longest-match/app-parser audit. Raw successful query evidence retained with explicit policy-blocked classification.
Most collection statistics are mixed holdings and undated or historical. Do not sum them or claim a national size ranking.
